name: Meningitis
tagline: Molala o sataletseng, hlooho e bohloko, lekhopho le pherese.
reviewer: Ho hlahloba ha tleliniki ho ntse ho emetse

urgent.heading: Urgent - ea sepetlele hona joale
urgent.primary_message: Bacterial meningitis e ka bolaea ka mor'a lihora tse seng kae. U se ke ua emela matšoao 'ohle - fihla sepetlele hang-hang.
red_flags: Lekhopho le bokhubelu bo bopherese le HA LE FUMANE ha le totoba ka tlas'a khalase
Molala o thata - ha o khone ho ama selelu ho ea sefubeng
Hlooho e bohloko haholo ka feberu le ho hlatsa
Kutloelo-bohloko ho khanya, melumo, kapa ho thetsoa
Pherekano, ho otsela, kapa bothata ba ho tsoha
Ho tsieleha kapa sello se phahameng sa lesea
Ho ruruha hloohong ea lesea, ka feberu le ho hana ho fepa

what_is_it.heading: Meningitis ka mantsoe a bonolo
what_is_it.lede: Meningitis ke tšoaetso ea meninges - likarolo tse sireletsang tse pota-potileng boko le lesapo la mokokotlo. Bacterial meningitis ke e 'ngoe ea mafu a bolaeang ka potlako a tsejoang.
paragraphs: Hangata meningitis e bakoa ke kokoana-hloko kapa baktheria. Viral meningitis hangata ha e bobebe 'me e ntlafala ka bo eona. Bacterial meningitis ke tšohanyetso ea 'nete - e ka bolaea motho ea phetseng hantle ka mor'a lihora tse ngata mme e hloka lithibela-mafu kapele.

Ho tsoa ka ntle, u ke ke ua khona ho khetholla tse peli ka botšepehi. Ke ka hona nyeoe e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe e belaelloang e tlamehang ho tšoaroa joalo ka baktheria ho fihlela ho netefalitsoe ka tsela e fapaneng. Afrika Boroa e tsamaisa mananeo a ente khahlanong le mefuta e kotsi ka ho fetisisa.

facts.heading: Lintho tse 'nè tseo u lokelang ho li tseba

items.headline: E bolaea ka lihora
items.body: Bacterial meningitis e ka tloha matšoao a pele ho isa lefung ka nako e ka tlase ho lihora tse 24. Lebelo la kalafo ke tsohle.

items.headline: Ente e ka thibeloang
items.body: Liente tsa mahala tsa bana tsa SA (Hib, Pneumococcal, Meningococcal) li thibela mefuta e kotsi ka ho fetisisa. Li fumane ka nako.

items.headline: Kotsi ea ho koala
items.body: E hasana ka ho khohlela, ho ethimola, ho aka, kapa ho arolelana lino-mapholi. Batho ba haufi ba ka fuoa lithibela-mafu e le tšireletso.

items.headline: Teko ea tumbler
items.body: Tobetsa khalase e hlakileng khahlanong le lekhopho. Haeba matheba a sa nyamele tlas'a khatello - e-ea sepetlele ka ho toba.

pull_quote.text: Tšepa kelello ea hau. Haeba ho na le ho hong ho phoso haholo - haholo-holo ho ngoana - u se ke ua emela matšoao a felletseng. E-ea sepetlele. Meningitis e ka bolaea pele matšoao 'ohle a hlaha.

signs.heading: Seo u lokelang ho se shebella
signs.lede: Matšoao a ka qala joalo ka feberu, ebe a mpefala kapele. Matšoao a khale a ka 'na a se ke a hlaha ka tatellano e tšoanang - kapa ho hang ho masea le bana ba banyenyane.

items.title: Batho ba baholo le bana ba baholo
items.description: Feberu e phahameng, hlooho e bohloko haholo, molala o sataletseng (o sitoa ho ama selelu sefubeng), kutlo e bobebe, ho nyekeloa ke pelo kapa ho hlatsa, pherekano kapa ho otsela.

items.title: Lekhopho le pherese
items.description: Matheba a manyane a bokgubedu bo pherese kapa dipatso tse shebahalang eka ke matetetso. E ata ka potlako. Ha e nyamele ha e hatelloa ka khalase - sena ke tšohanyetso.

items.title: Bana le bana ba banyenyane
items.description: Sello se phahameng haholo sa ho lla, ho hana lijo, ho fofa haholo kapa ho satalla haholo, letheba le hlabang, letlalo le letšo kapa le lerootho, feberu e nang le matsoho le maoto a batang.

items.title: Lipheletso tse batang pele
items.description: Matsoho le maoto a batang ha 'mele o ntse o chesa, mahlaba a matla a maoto, le letlalo le letšo ka mokhoa o sa tloaelehang e ka ba matšoao a pejana ho feta lekhopho kapa molala o sataletseng.

spreads.heading: Kamoo meningitis e jalang kateng
yes: Ho khohlela le ho ethimola ho motho ya jereng baktheria
Ho aka kapa ho koala kamano e telele
Ho arolelana linoelo, libotlolo tsa metsi, lisakerete, kapa lijana
Ho lula libakeng tse haufi - libaka tsa bolulo tsa univesithi, matlo a sesole, lichankana
no: Ho kopana feela joalo ka ho ts'oarana ka matsoho kapa ho ba ka phapusing e le 'ngoe
Litulo tsa matloana, matamo a ho sesa, kapa maoatla a mamati
Ho longoa ke menoang kapa likokoanyana
Liphoofolo tse ruuoang lapeng le liphoofolo

prevention.heading: Mokhoa oa ho itšireletsa le ba lelapa la hau
prevention.lede: Meento e sireletsa khahlanong le mefuta e kotsi ka ho fetisisa ea meningitis ea baktheria. Ke mahala tleliniking e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe ea 'muso ea SA bakeng sa bana, 'me e khothaletsoa ho batho ba baholo ba kotsing e kholo.

items.title: Liente tsa mahala tsa bongoana
items.description: Hib ka libeke tse 6, 10, 14. Pneumococcal libeke tse 6, libeke tse 14, likhoeli tse 9. Meningococcal moo e bontšitsoeng. Latela kemiso ea SA.

items.title: Lihlopha tse nang le kotsi e kholo
items.description: Baithuti ba univesithi libakeng tsa bolulo, ba ngolisitsoeng sesoleng, baeti ba lebanta la African meningitis kapa Hajj - botsa ngaka ea hau ka ente ea Meningococcal ACWY.

items.title: Haeba motho ea haufi a kula
items.description: Litho tsa malapa le batho ba haufi le lefu la meningitis ea baktheria hangata ba fuoa lithibela-mafu ke Public Health. Ba nke - ba sebetsa.

items.title: Lemoha kapele — nka khato kapele
items.description: Ho tseba matšoao ho pholosa bophelo. Tšepa kelello ea hau. Haeba ho na le ho hong ho phoso, leba sepetlele.

myths.heading: Seo eleng nnete le seo eseng sona

items.myth: Ke masea le bana feela ba tšoaroang ke meningitis.
items.fact: Masea, bacha, le bacha ba baholo ba kotsing e kholo, empa e ka hlasela lilemo life kapa life. Ho qhoma ha bolulo ba bacha le ba univesithi ho tloaelehile.

items.myth: Haeba lekhopho le ntse le fela ha ke le hatella, ha se meningitis.
items.fact: Qalong ea meningitis lekhopho le ntse le ka fela. Haeba matšoao a mang a le teng - hlooho, feberu, ho satalla molala - e-ea sepetlele ho sa tsotellehe hore na ke eng.

items.myth: Li-antibiotics tsa pele tsa tleliniki li lekane.
items.fact: Bacterial meningitis e hloka lithibela-mafu tse kenngoang ka methapo sepetlele, hammoho le ho hlahlojoa. Li-antibiotics tsa letlapa feela ha lia lekana.

items.myth: Meento ea meningitis e baka meningitis.
items.fact: Meento e sireletsa khahlanong le lisosa tse atileng haholo tsa baktheria. Ha li bake lefu lena. Meento ea kemiso ea bongoana e bolokehile ebile e pholosa bophelo.

action_steps.heading: Seo u lokelang ho se etsa - nako eo u belaelang meningitis

items.title: Etsa tlhahlobo ea tumbler
items.description: Tobetsa lehlakore la khalase e hlakileng ka tieo khahlanong le lekhopho. Haeba matheba a lula a bonahala ka khalase - e-ea sepetlele hona joale.

items.title: Letsetsa 10177 kapa u ee ka kotloloho kamoreng ea tšohanyetso
items.description: E re 'ho belaelloang meningitis' ha u ntse u potlaka hore u tle u bonoe hang-hang. Se ke oa emela kopano ea ngaka.

items.title: Hlokomela hore na matšoao a qalile neng
items.description: Nako ea bohlokoa. Bolella sehlopha sa sepetlele ha feberu, hlooho e opang, lekhopho, kapa phetoho ea boitšoaro e qalile.

items.title: U se ke ua emela matšoao 'ohle
items.description: Mofuta o tloaelehileng oa feberu, molala o sataletseng le hlooho e ka 'na ea se ke ea bonahala kaofela hammoho. E 'ngoe le e 'ngoe e le 'ngoe ke lebaka la ho hlahlojoa.

items.title: Bolella mabitso a haufi
items.description: Mang kapa mang ea arolelaneng le lelapa, senoelo, kapa ho aka bekeng e fetileng o tlameha ho ikopanya le Public Health bakeng sa likeletso. Ho ka fanoa ka lithibela-mafu prophylaxis.

get_help.heading: O ka letsetsa mang hona jwale
get_help.lede: Ho belaelloang hore ke bacterial meningitis ke a mang a mafu a seng makae ao 'ho ea sepetlele hona joale' e leng karabo e nepahetseng - le ka 3am, leha o sa tiiseha.
